input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the bay mountains with the Sugarloaf and the woman (small, head to feet between 22% and 48% of the frame height, between 42% and 58% of the width) sit in the upper half, mountain tops never touching the top edge. The lower half is calm wet sand and foam, mid-tone, not bright. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
